NVIDIA's Nemotron 3.5 Parse open-sources 18.88M synthetic training examples to improve document extraction reliability. Shifting table rows or missing chart axes causes silent structural failures in RAG pipelines. The release combines supervised fine-tuning with reinforcement learning (GRPO) to reduce generation loops, alongside a DFlash2 speculator that accelerates inference through draft proposal verification. #AI #DocumentProcessing #OpenData #MachineLearning
